Several [[Standard year/Legends|years]] after the [[Treaty of Coruscant]] began the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] in [[3653 BBY]], the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] sent a small group of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] to the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] holy world of [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]] to investigate the [[Planet/Legends|planet's]] reserves of potentially valuable [[Adegan crystal/Legends|Adegan crystals]]. The Sith managed to avoid the few [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] on Ilum, leaving the Jedi largely unaware of their presence as the strike team began to quietly harvest crystals.<ref name="The Battle for Ilum" /> 

However, in [[3640 BBY]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> the Empire's [[Scientist/Legends|scientists]] discovered that Adegan crystals could be used in the development of [[Cloaking device/Legends|stealth technology]],<ref name="The Final Front">{{TORcite|type=faction|Imperial|The Final Front|Ilum}}</ref> and they launched an [[Battle of Ilum|invasion of the planet]] to take advantage of the crystal deposits.<ref name="Holonet">{{Holonet|planets|ilum|Ilum}}</ref>
